student_description: This student understands academic content in English but struggles with active L2 production, exhibiting frequent pauses, fillers, and false starts when put on the spot. They uniquely require structured preparation time before speaking and sustained support in academic language to bridge the gap between their content comprehension and L2 expressive abilities.

criteria.rationale: Sustained focus on academic L2 proficiency equips the student with the necessary linguistic tools to express their existing content knowledge fluently.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan must incorporate dedicated, intensive instruction focused specifically on academic L2 proficiency (such as bridging courses or targeted academic language modules) alongside or prior to content instruction.
